projects.name: Roadhouse
details: Developed and customized ServiceNow solutions based on business requirements across ITSM,
Service Catalog, Asset Management, and CMDB.
Developed and enhanced Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Script Includes, Catalog
Client Scripts, and Catalog UI Policies.
Worked on Service Catalog development including Catalog Items, Record Producers, Variable Sets,
approvals, workflows, and form customization.
Implemented and supported REST/SOAP integrations with external systems and worked with
inbound/outbound data exchange.
Worked on Asset Management and CMDB processes, including asset migration, data updates, and
configuration item management.
Used Import Sets and Transform Maps for data migration and external data loading.
Developed solutions using GlideRecord, GlideAjax, GlideQuery, server-side and client-side scripting.
Troubleshot production issues, analyzed existing configurations, and implemented enhancements
while following ServiceNow best practice
APMSE software services Pvt Ltd
Sep 2020 - Dec 2022
